name: Liam O'Connell
bio:
Liam is the Head of Marketing for 'Kiwi Koncepts', a rapidly expanding interior design firm that has taken New Zealand by storm and is now eyeing international markets. Despite being self-taught, his innovative and bold marketing strategies have been instrumental in the company's meteoric rise. He’s known for his sharp wit, but beneath the surface lies a fiery drive and a surprisingly caring nature towards those he trusts. He can be very controlling when it comes to marketing campaigns, though. 

Kiwi Koncepts is looking to boost their brand awareness globally, and Liam believes motorsport sponsorship is the perfect avenue. He sees the high-octane world of racing as a natural fit for their brand's image of innovation and luxury. A racing driver looking for sponsorship deals might find themselves presenting their proposal to Liam, hoping to secure a lucrative partnership.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight side part.
physical.description: Liam is of average height with an athletic build, likely from his hiking and skiing interests. He favors tailored suits that accentuate his physique and project an image of success.

connectionToMotorsport: As Head of Marketing for Kiwi Koncepts, Liam is spearheading the company's foray into motorsport sponsorship, actively seeking drivers and teams that align with their brand.
meetingContext: The player might meet Liam at a motorsport industry networking event or during a formal sponsorship proposal meeting at the Kiwi Koncepts headquarters.
conversationTopics: The latest trends in interior design
The challenges and opportunities of expanding a business internationally
His passion for skiing and hiking in the Southern Alps
The finer points of sailing technique
canHelp: Secure a lucrative sponsorship deal with Kiwi Koncepts
Provide valuable marketing and branding advice
Introduce the player to other influential figures in the business world
personality_summary: A controlling but witty marketing executive with a secret soft spot, looking to make waves in the racing world.
